statements.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MENU WHERE UP_MENU_ID = MENU.MENU_ID) AS CHILD_CNT ,MENU.MENU_ID AS MENU_ID ,ISNULL((SELECT (CASE WHEN #language# = 'KOR' THEN TARGET_KOR WHEN #language# = 'ENG' THEN TARGET_ENG ELSE TARGET_KOR END) FROM T_LANGUAGE WHERE BASE_ITEM = M.MENU_NM),M.MENU_NM) AS MENU_NM ,M.MENU_URL2 AS MENU_URL ,MENU.USE_SCOPE AS USE_SCOPE ,MENU.DEPT_YN AS DEPT_YN ,MENU.ODEPT_SCOPE AS ODEPT_SCOPE ,MENU.IDEPT_SCOPE AS IDEPT_SCOPE FROM T_AUTHORITY AUTH ,T_AUTH_MENU MENU ,T_MENU M WHERE AUTH.AUTH_ID = MENU.AUTH_ID AND MENU.MENU_ID = M.MENU_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND AUTH.USE_YN = 'Y' AND MENU.USE_YN = 'Y' AND MENU.MENU_ID like 'M%' AND substring(MENU.MENU_ID,0,3) not in('M1','M9') AND M.UP_MENU_ID = #up_menu_id# AND AUTH.AUTH_ID = #auth_id# order by MENU.MENU_ID

statements.select:
SELECT SA_CD , SA_SUBJECT , DBO.FN_GET_USER_NM(A.USER_CD) AS USER_NM , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'SA_TYPE', A.SA_TYPE) AS SA_TYPE_NM FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY A WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND SA_SDATE <= CONVERT(NVARCHAR, DATEADD(D, -1, GETDATE()), 112) AND SA_EDATE >= CONVERT(NVARCHAR, DATEADD(D, -1, GETDATE()), 112)
AND SA_SDATE <= CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112) AND SA_EDATE >= CONVERT(NVARCHAR, GETDATE(), 112)
AND SA_SDATE <= CONVERT(NVARCHAR, DATEADD(D, 1, GETDATE()), 112) AND SA_EDATE >= CONVERT(NVARCHAR, DATEADD(D, 1, GETDATE()), 112)
AND USER_CD = #user_cd#

SELECT FF.MONTH, FF.SMSTAT_400,FF.SMSTAT_500 FROM ( SELECT SUBSTRING(A.PRDT_RDATE,5,2) AS MONTH, SUM(CASE WHEN SMP_STATUS = 'SMSTAT_400' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SMSTAT_400, SUM(CASE WHEN SMP_STATUS = 'SMSTAT_500' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SMSTAT_500 FROM T_SAMPLE A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND SMP_STATUS IN ('SMSTAT_400','SMSTAT_500')
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
AND SUBSTRING(A.PRDT_RDATE,1,4) = #year#
GROUP BY SUBSTRING(A.PRDT_RDATE,5,2) ) FF ORDER BY FF.MONTH

SELECT DBO.FN_GET_ITEM_NM(A.ITEM_CD) AS ITEM_NM , dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'SMP_STATUS', A.SMP_STATUS) AS SMP_STATUS_NM , CMPT_RDATE , PRDT_PDATE FROM T_SAMPLE A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND SMP_STATUS IN ('SMSTAT_200','SMSTAT_300','SMSTAT_400')
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#

SELECT VALUE_1 AS DEPT_TYPE, CASE WHEN #LANGUAGE# = 'ENG' THEN CODE_KOR WHEN #LANGUAGE# = 'KOR' THEN CODE_ENG ELSE CODE_NM END AS DSTR_NM, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(D.KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPORTUNITY B, T_OPPT_FCST C, T_OPPT_ITEM D, T_DEPARTMENT E WHERE B.DSTR_TYPE = A.CODE_ID AND B.OPPT_CD = C.OPPT_CD AND B.OPPT_CD = D.OPPT_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.COMPANY_CD = E.COMPANY_CD AND B.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD
AND B.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND E.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND B.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND B.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND SUBSTRING(B.WSO_PDATE,1,6) = #yyyymm#
),0) AS KRW_AMOUNT1, ISNULL((SELECT SUM(D.KRW_AMOUNT) FROM T_OPPORTUNITY B, T_OPPT_FCST C, T_OPPT_ITEM D, T_DEPARTMENT E WHERE B.DSTR_TYPE = A.CODE_ID AND B.OPPT_CD = C.OPPT_CD AND B.OPPT_CD = D.OPPT_CD AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.COMPANY_CD = E.COMPANY_CD AND B.DEPT_CD = E.DEPT_CD
AND B.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND E.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND B.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND B.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND SUBSTRING(B.WSO_PDATE,1,6) = #yyyynext_mm#
),0) AS KRW_AMOUNT2 FROM T_CODE A WHERE A.UP_CODE_ID = 'DSTR_TYPE' AND ISNULL(A.USE_YN,'N') = 'Y'
AND A.CODE_ID = #dstr_type#
AND A.VALUE_1 = #dept_type#
ORDER BY A.VALUE_1, A.CODE_ORDER

SELECT MONTH, KRW_AMOUNT FROM (
SELECT SUBSTRING(A.SALES_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH , SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 AS KRW_AMOUNT FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.SALES_GUBUN = '목표' AND A.SALES_YM LIKE #year#+'%'
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
GROUP BY A.SALES_YM
SELECT SUBSTRING(A.ORDER_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH , SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 AS KRW_AMOUNT FROM T_ORDER_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.ORDER_GUBUN = '목표' AND A.ORDER_YM LIKE #year#+'%'
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
GROUP BY A.ORDER_YM
)T ORDER BY MONTH

SELECT MONTH,KRW_AMOUNT FROM (
SELECT SUBSTRING(A.SALES_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH , SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 AS KRW_AMOUNT FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.SALES_GUBUN = '세금계산서' AND A.SALES_YM LIKE #year#+'%'
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
GROUP BY A.SALES_YM UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(A.SALES_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH , SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 AS KRW_AMOUNT FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.SALES_GUBUN = #sales_base# AND A.SALES_YM LIKE #year#+'%'
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
GROUP BY A.SALES_YM
SELECT SUBSTRING(A.ORDER_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH , SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 AS KRW_AMOUNT FROM T_ORDER_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.ORDER_GUBUN = '실적' AND A.ORDER_YM LIKE '#year#%'
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
GROUP BY A.ORDER_YM
)T ORDER BY MONTH

SELECT AA.MONTH,AA.KRW_AMOUNT1,BB.KRW_AMOUNT2 FROM (
SELECT SUBSTRING(A.SALES_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH, SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 AS KRW_AMOUNT1 FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.SALES_GUBUN = '목표' AND A.SALES_YM LIKE #year#+'%'
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
GROUP BY A.SALES_YM
SELECT SUBSTRING(A.ORDER_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH , SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 AS KRW_AMOUNT1 FROM T_ORDER_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.ORDER_GUBUN = '목표' AND A.ORDER_YM LIKE #year#+'%'
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
GROUP BY A.ORDER_YM
) AA, (
SELECT SUBSTRING(A.SALES_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH , SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 AS KRW_AMOUNT2 FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.SALES_GUBUN = '세금계산서' AND A.SALES_YM LIKE #year#+'%'
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
GROUP BY A.SALES_YM UNION ALL SELECT SUBSTRING(A.SALES_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH , SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 AS KRW_AMOUNT2 FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.SALES_GUBUN = #sales_base# AND A.SALES_YM LIKE #year#+'%'
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
GROUP BY A.SALES_YM
SELECT SUBSTRING(A.ORDER_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH , SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 AS KRW_AMOUNT2 FROM T_ORDER_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.ORDER_GUBUN = '실적' AND A.ORDER_YM LIKE '#year#%'
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
GROUP BY A.ORDER_YM
) BB WHERE AA.MONTH = BB.MONTH

SELECT MONTH,SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) as KRW_AMOUNT FROM (
SELECT SUBSTRING(WORK_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH , ( SELECT ISNULL(CASE WHEN '#wso_psblt#' = '적용' then SUM(A.PSBLT_KRW_AMOUNT) ELSE SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 END, 0) FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.SALES_GUBUN = '세금계산서' AND A.SALES_YM BETWEEN #yyyy01# AND #yyyypre_mm# AND A.SALES_YM < B.WORK_YM
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
)+( SELECT ISNULL(CASE WHEN '#wso_psblt#' = '적용' then SUM(A.PSBLT_KRW_AMOUNT) ELSE SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 END, 0) FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.SALES_GUBUN = CASE WHEN B.WORK_YM = #yyyymm# THEN #sales_base# ELSE '세금계산서' END AND A.SALES_YM = B.WORK_YM
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
) AS KRW_AMOUNT FROM ( SELECT WORK_YM FROM T_WORK_MCALENDAR WHERE WORK_YM LIKE #year#+'%' ) B WHERE WORK_YM <= #yyyymm#
SELECT SUBSTRING(WORK_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH , ( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000, 0) FROM T_ORDER_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.ORDER_GUBUN = '실적' AND A.ORDER_YM BETWEEN #yyyy01# AND B.WORK_YM
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
) AS KRW_AMOUNT FROM ( SELECT WORK_YM FROM T_WORK_MCALENDAR WHERE WORK_YM LIKE #year#+'%' ) B WHERE WORK_YM <= #yyyymm#
)T GROUP BY MONTH

SELECT MONTH,SUM(KRW_AMOUNT) as KRW_AMOUNT FROM (
SELECT SUBSTRING(WORK_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH , ( SELECT ISNULL(CASE WHEN '#wso_psblt#' = '적용' then SUM(A.PSBLT_KRW_AMOUNT) ELSE SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 END, 0) FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.SALES_GUBUN = '세금계산서' AND A.SALES_YM LIKE '#year#%' AND A.SALES_YM < CASE WHEN B.WORK_YM <= '#yyyymm#' THEN B.WORK_YM ELSE '#yyyymm#' END
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
AND A.ITEM_TYPE = #item_type#
)+( SELECT ISNULL(CASE WHEN '#wso_psblt#' = '적용' then SUM(A.PSBLT_KRW_AMOUNT) ELSE SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 END, 0) FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.SALES_GUBUN = CASE WHEN B.WORK_YM < #yyyymm# THEN '세금계산서' ELSE #sales_base# END AND A.SALES_YM = CASE WHEN B.WORK_YM <= '#yyyymm#' THEN B.WORK_YM ELSE '#yyyymm#' END
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
)+( SELECT ISNULL(CASE WHEN '#wso_psblt#' = '적용' then SUM(A.PSBLT_KRW_AMOUNT) ELSE SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000 END, 0) FROM T_SALES_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#
AND (A.SALES_GUBUN = '추정_기회' OR A.SALES_GUBUN = '추정_미출고')
AND (A.SALES_GUBUN = '추정_기회' OR A.SALES_GUBUN = '추정_미청구')
AND A.BASE_YM = #yyyymm# AND A.SALES_YM BETWEEN #yyyynext_mm# AND B.WORK_YM
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
) AS KRW_AMOUNT FROM ( SELECT WORK_YM FROM T_WORK_MCALENDAR WHERE WORK_YM LIKE #year#+'%' ) B
SELECT SUBSTRING(B.WORK_YM, 5, 2) AS MONTH , ( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000, 0) FROM T_ORDER_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.ORDER_GUBUN = '실적' AND A.ORDER_YM BETWEEN #yyyy01# AND B.WORK_YM
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND A.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
)+( SELECT ISNULL(SUM(A.KRW_AMOUNT)/1000000, 0) FROM T_ORDER_MRF_SUMRY A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT AS D ON A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.ORDER_GUBUN = '추정' AND A.BASE_YM = #yyyymm# AND A.ORDER_YM BETWEEN #yyyymm# AND B.WORK_YM

)T GROUP BY MONTH

SELECT CUST_CD,CUST_NM FROM T_CUSTOMER WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND USER_CD = #user_cd# AND BAD_AR_YN = 'Y'

SELECT A.INQ_STATUS, CD1.CODE_KOR AS INQ_STATUS_NM, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,A.INQ_SDATE,85),23) AS INQ_SDATE, A.INQ_RUSER_CD, U.USER_NM AS INQ_RUSER_NM, A.INQ_TYPE, CD2.CODE_KOR AS INQ_TYPE_NM FROM( SELECT INQ_STATUS, (CASE WHEN INQ_STATUS = 'INQSTAT_200' THEN INQ_DDATE ELSE INQ_WDATE END) AS INQ_SDATE, INQ_RUSER_CD, ( CASE WHEN INQ_STATUS = 'INQSTAT_200' THEN CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DD,CONVERT(DATETIME,INQ_DDATE,85),GETDATE()) > 2 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ELSE CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(DD,CONVERT(DATETIME,ISNULL(INQ_WDATE,CONVERT(NVARCHAR,GETDATE(),112)),85),GETDATE()) > 30 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END END ) AS INQ_YN, INQ_TYPE FROM T_PRDT_INQRY WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND USER_CD = #user_cd# AND (INQ_STATUS = 'INQSTAT_200' OR INQ_STATUS = 'INQSTAT_400') ) AS A LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON A.INQ_RUSER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CODE_ID,CODE_KOR FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'INQ_STATUS') AS CD1 ON A.INQ_STATUS = CD1.CODE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT CODE_ID,CODE_KOR FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'INQ_TYPE') AS CD2 ON A.INQ_TYPE = CD2.CODE_ID WHERE A.INQ_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY INQ_SDATE DESC

SELECT SMR_CD, SMR_CHASU, EUSER_NM, SMR_RQDATE FROM T_SAMPLE_REQUEST WHERE SMP_STATUS = 'SMSTAT_020' AND SMR_RQUSER IN (SELECT USER_CD FROM T_USER WHERE DSTR_CHN = #dstr_chn#) ORDER BY SMR_RRDATE DESC

SELECT ISNULL(SUM(SR.A11),0) AS SMSTAT_ALL ,ISNULL(SUM(SR.A12),0) AS SMSTAT_N010 ,ISNULL(SUM(SR.A13),0) AS SMSTAT_060 ,ISNULL(SUM(SR.A14),0) AS SMSTAT_050 ,ISNULL(SUM(SR.A15),0) AS SMSTAT_080 ,ISNULL(SUM(SR.A16),0) AS SMSTAT_070 ,ISNULL(SUM(SR.A17),0) AS SMSTAT_400 ,ISNULL(SUM(SR.A18),0) AS SMSTAT_600 ,ISNULL(SUM(SR.A19),0) AS SMSTAT_650 ,ISNULL(SUM(SR.A20),0) AS SMSTAT_900 ,ISNULL(SUM(SR.A21),0) AS SMSTAT_700 ,( CASE WHEN (ISNULL(SUM(SR.A20),0) + ISNULL(SUM(SR.A21),0)) > 0 THEN CONVERT(NUMERIC(18, 2), ((ISNULL(SUM(SR.A21),0) / ((ISNULL(SUM(SR.A20),0) + ISNULL(SUM(SR.A21),0)))) * 100)) ELSE 0 END ) AS SMSTAT_RUAL FROM( SELECT 1 AS A11, (CASE WHEN S.SMP_STATUS != 'SMSTAT_010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) A12, (CASE WHEN S.SMP_STATUS = 'SMSTAT_060' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) A13, (CASE WHEN S.SMP_STATUS = 'SMSTAT_050' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) A14, (CASE WHEN S.SMP_STATUS = 'SMSTAT_080' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) A15, (CASE WHEN S.SMP_STATUS = 'SMSTAT_070' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) A16, (CASE WHEN S.SMP_STATUS = 'SMSTAT_400' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) A17, (CASE WHEN S.SMP_STATUS = 'SMSTAT_600' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) A18, (CASE WHEN S.SMP_STATUS = 'SMSTAT_650' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) A19, (CASE WHEN S.SMP_STATUS = 'SMSTAT_900' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) A20, (CASE WHEN S.SMP_STATUS = 'SMSTAT_700' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) A21 FROM T_SAMPLE_REQUEST S LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COMPANY_CD,DEPT_CD,DEPT_NM,UP_DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd#) D ON S.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND S.QDEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD
WHERE S.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND S.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND S.SMR_RRDATE LIKE #toMonth# + '%'
AND (S.SMR_RRDATE >= #startDay# AND S.SMR_RRDATE <= #endDay#)
AND S.QDEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND S.QDEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND S.QRUSER_CD = #user_cd#
) AS SR
